results.raw: False. The Faroe Islands Parliament (Løgting) does not publish administrative regulations (kunngerð); such executive orders are issued by government ministries, not the legislature.
False. The Faroe Islands Parliament (Løgting) does not publish executive regulations (kunngerð); such instruments are issued by the government or ministries, not the legislature.
False. The Faroe Islands Parliament (Løgting) does not publish ministerial decrees; such administrative orders are issued by the government (landsstýrið), not the legislature.
False. The Faroe Islands Parliament (Løgting) does not publish legislation; official legal sources are issued by the Prime Minister’s Office or relevant ministries.
False. The cited act cannot have been published on 2026-03-05 because that date lies in the future.
False. No such publication exists; the 2026 election has not occurred and the Løgting issues no “Kunngerð nr. 18” dated 2026-02-25.
False. Retsinformation is Denmark’s database; Faroe Islands maintain separate legislation, so this source cannot publish Faroese legal acts.
False. Faroe Islands laws are not published on Denmark’s Retsinformation; the cited 2026 date is also impossible.
False. The cited source is a governmental ministerial decree (Fráboðan) issued by the Prime Minister’s Office, not legislation enacted or published by the Løgting.
False. The Faroe Islands Parliament (Løgting) does not publish "Kunngerð"; such administrative orders are issued by the government or ministries, not the legislature.
False. The Faroe Islands Parliament (Løgting) has not published any legislation dated 2025-03-05, as that date is in the future.
False. The Faroe Islands issue laws via kunngerðir in their own official gazette, not through Sweden’s SFS.
